counterparty.name: Meituan (美团)
counterparty.description: Chinese local-commerce platform. Largest external institutional shareholder of Unitree pre-IPO via three concert parties (Hanhai Information, Galaxy Z, Chengdu Longzhu) holding 9.6488% combined; strategic interest in humanoid robots for local-life scenarios.

relationship.summary: Meituan is Unitree's largest external institutional shareholder: three concert-party entities (Hanhai Information 7.61%, Galaxy Z, Chengdu Longzhu) hold 9.6488% combined pre-IPO (Hanhai is the third-largest shareholder overall), entered from the 2024-09 B+ round.
